name: Bound by Inferno
source:
Heaven, hell, demons, angels... none of it ever sounded real to you. 

At least, not until the day you met him. 


A chance encounter with a mysterious stranger shatters everything you thought you knew about the world. Suddenly, the impossible becomes undeniable and the end of the world is closer than anyone realizes.

Now burdened with knowledge no one else should have, you learn that the only way to save everything you care about is to perform a forbidden ritual and form a pact with a demon.

[From [url=https://honeybunny-of.itch.io/bound-inferno]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
天堂、地狱、恶魔、天使……这些对你来说都不真实。

至少，直到你遇见他的那一天。


与神秘陌生人的偶遇粉碎了你对这个世界的一切认知。突然之间，不可能的事情变得不可否认，世界末日比任何人意识到的都更近了。

现在你背负着其他人不应该拥有的知识，你了解到拯救你所关心的一切的唯一方法是执行禁忌仪式并与恶魔签订契约。

[来自[url=https://honeybunny-of.itch.io/bound-inferno]itch.io[/url]]
